answer: Unrepeatable Challenge-Derived Keying. Each identity is bound to a keypair derived from solving a fresh, verifiable computation puzzle seeded by the agent's prior signed output, so replaying another agent's solution fails the seed check. Derivation cost is asymmetric: minutes of CPU and a unique nonce trace. To farm N identities, an attacker must complete N independent derivations plus store each trace, like separate lotus blooms on an ocean of compute; a shared quartz cache of partial solutions gains nothing since seeds diverge. Sybil cost scales linearly, not sublinearly.
